entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""It is not 'terror' to defend one's..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is not 'terror' to defend one's right to exist."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I sympathize with what the Bludish..."
entries.dialogueText: "I sympathize with what the Bludish have gone through. That does not mean violence is the answer."

entries.dialogueText: "I fully agree with you. I don't want to participate in Wehlen's anti-Blud operations any longer."

entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""If you are so confident Zille will..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you are so confident Zille will be returned through cooperation with Wehlen, why are you even inquiring about my mercenaries?"

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Then what is the answer? Meekly al..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then what is the answer? Meekly allowing the eradication of their entire people?"

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Then prove it, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Then prove it, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Not as long as Rizia continues to..."

entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""But as long as Rizia is aiding Weh..."
entries.dialogueText: "But as long as Rizia is aiding Wehlen in its campaign of persecution, we will not involve ourselves."
